import os,subprocess,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for arm in ['on']:
 out=root/f'ordinary-{arm}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 fixture=root/'diagnostic-ordinary/fixture'
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GPU_PHYSICS_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}
 env.update(RAIN_CELL_ROW='3',RAIN_CELL_COLUMN='9',RAIN_REPLAY_BASE='3907',RAIN_REPLAY_STATE=str(root/'initial.txt'),RAIN_REPLAY_LIMITS='1',RAIN_REPLAY_HEALTH='1',RAIN_REPLAY_COLLISIONS='1',GPU_PHYSICS_LIVE_CONTACT_ORDER='0',WGPU_BACKEND='vulkan',GPU_PHYSICS_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR=str(Path.home()/'.cache/box3d-gpu-physics/pipelines'))
 if arm=='on':env.update(GPU_PHYSICS_AB='phase-capture',RAIN_DIAGNOSTIC_PHASE_FILE=str(out/'phases.bin'))
 command=[str(fixture),'120'];start=time.monotonic()
 (out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),environment={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith(('GPU_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}),indent=2))
 with (out/'state.txt').open('w') as stdout,(out/'run.log').open('w') as stderr:r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 (out/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start),indent=2))
 print(arm,r.returncode,flush=True)
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
base=root.parent/'rain-hip-phase-replay/ordinary-on/state.txt'
assert (root/'ordinary-on/state.txt').read_bytes()==base.read_bytes()
print('physical body stream exact',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import struct,json,math,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;old=p.parent/'rain-hip-phase-replay/ordinary-on';out=p/'ordinary-on'
assert json.loads((out/'exit.json').read_text())['exit']==0
assert (out/'state.txt').read_bytes()==(old/'state.txt').read_bytes()
a=(out/'phases.bin').read_bytes();b=(old/'phases.bin').read_bytes();assert len(a)==len(b)
offset=0;rows=[];max_error=0.;max_ratio=0.;frames=0
labels=['spring','motor','twist','cone','point']
while offset<len(a):
 frame,n=struct.unpack_from('<II',a,offset);assert (frame,n)==struct.unpack_from('<II',b,offset) and frame==frames and n==8448
 offset+=8
 u=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*n,a,offset);v=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*n,b,offset);f=struct.unpack_from('<'+'f'*n,a,offset);offset+=4*n
 assert u[:192]==v[:192]
 for phase in range(24):
  start=192+phase*43*8
  assert u[start+8:start+43*8]==v[start+8:start+43*8],(frame,phase,'dynamic phase changed')
  assert u[start+6:start+8]==(29,37)
 for sub in range(4):
  for mode,phase in [('warm',3+5*sub),('bias',4+5*sub),('relax',6+5*sub)]:
   start=192+phase*43*8;values=f[start:start+6];assert all(map(math.isfinite,values))
   error=abs(sum(values[:5])-values[5]);bound=8*2**-23*max(1.,sum(map(abs,values)))
   assert error<=bound,(frame,sub,mode,error,bound)
   max_error=max(max_error,error);max_ratio=max(max_ratio,error/bound)
   rows.append(dict(frame=frame,substep=sub,mode=mode,work=dict(zip(labels,values[:5])),total=values[5]))
 frames+=1
assert frames==120 and offset==len(a) and any(abs(r['total'])>1e-5 for r in rows)
summary={}
for subset,records in [('all',rows),('tail60',[r for r in rows if r['frame']>=60])]:
 summary[subset]={}
 for mode in ['warm','bias','relax']:
  selected=[r for r in records if r['mode']==mode]
  summary[subset][mode]={'observations':len(selected),'mean_total_J':sum(r['total'] for r in selected)/len(selected),'sum_total_J':sum(r['total'] for r in selected),'mean_row_J':{key:sum(r['work'][key] for r in selected)/len(selected) for key in labels},'positive_total_count':sum(r['total']>0 for r in selected)}
result={'scope':'Exact target hip pair kinetic change per spherical row/pass; not stored-energy work or full physical acceptance. Warm pass uses spring lane for whole warm-start change, other4lanes zero. Inertia uses current dq orientation; solver calculations unchanged.','frames':frames,'pass_observations':len(rows),'physical_body_stream_exact':True,'all_dynamic_phase_words_exact':True,'all_phase_summaries_exact':True,'max_float32_telescoping_error_J':max_error,'max_roundoff_bound_fraction':max_ratio,'summary':summary,'sha256':{str(x):hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in [out/'state.txt',out/'phases.bin',out/'run.log']}}
(p/'row-work.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

interpretation: Target hip updates net remove pair kinetic energy on average. Cone bias adds kinetic energy with relaxation largely reversing it; springs and motors remove energy on average. Coupled contact/other-joint exchange and compliant stored energy remain unaccounted: no physical acceptance and no sole hip energy-source claim.
